questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Spot the mistakes: find and fix the 5 misspelled words.
questions.answer: furst → first; burd → bird; chirch → church; therd → third; hirt → hurt
questions.hint: Look at every word with the /er/ sound.
questions.text: On the furst day of term, Nia saw a little burd on the chirch roof. It was the therd time she saw it there. She did not want it to get hirt, so she put out some seeds. Then it was her turn to feed the fish in class.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Which spelling of the number after second is correct?

questions.subject: en_spell

questions.hint: It is spelled like turn.

questions.subject: en_spell

questions.hint: Say each word and look at the letters after the first one.

questions.subject: en_spell
questions.q: Spot the mistakes in the park story: find and fix the 5 misspelled words.
questions.answer: tern → turn; gerl → girl; hert → hurt; therd → third; ferst → first
questions.hint: Check if each /er/ word uses er, ir or ur.
questions.text: Sam and his sister went to the park. Sam had a go on the swing, and then it was her tern. A gerl fell over and her knee hert, so her mum gave her a big hug. "You were the therd to go down the slide," said Sam. "I will be the ferst next time!"
